content: Jesucristo cuti causarishcamanda
Domingo punzha tutapagaricta chi huarmigunaga alichishca asnaccunata apasha pambashca juctuma rinaura.
Chibi pactasha juctu pungüi tapashca jatun rumita anchuchishcata ricunaura,
astahuanbas juctu ucuma yaicusha Jesuspa aichata mana tupanaurachu.
Chita mana tupasha imata tucushca nisha manzharisha shayaushcai cungaimanda paiguna mayanbi ishcai (2) runa shayaric shamunaura. Chigunaga yapa ruyac chiujlla churarishca manaura.
Chi huarmiguna paigunata ricusha yapa manzharisha allpama cumuricpi chi cariguna rimanaura, Imangahuata causauctaga pambashcaibi mascangahua shamunguichi ninaura.
Paiga ña causarishca, caibi illanmi. Chara Galilea llactai aushallata ima tucungaraushcata cangunata yachachishcataga cungariranguichichu. Yuyarichi.

Pai cangunata yachachiusha rimara, ñucata juchayuc runagunahua maquibi cuitucungarauni, chasnallata cruspi quilabasha huanchihuangaraunguna. Chasnallata cangunatas yachachira quimsa (3) punzhaibi huañushcamanda cuti causaringarauni nishami rimara.
Paiguna chasna nicpi huarmiguna cuti yuyarinaura Jesus chasna rimashcata.
Chasna cuti yuyarisha paita pambashca juctumanda bulltiasha Jesus japishca chunga shuc (11) runagunamas shuccunamas tucui chibi pasashcata cuintangahua rinaura.
Chi rimac huarmiguna anaura Maria Magdalena, Juana, Santiagohua mama Maria, chi shuc paigunahuan auc huarmigunahuas chimandas cuintanaura.
Chasna cuintagrinaupi Jesus japishca runaguna yangami ninguichi nisha mana quirinaurachu.

Chi rimashcata mana quirishallata Pedro jatarisha Jesusta pambashca juctuma callpara ricungahua. Pactasha cumurisha ucuma ricugrisha pillushca llachapalla siriucta ricura. Chillata ricusha imata tucura nisha huasima bulltiara.
Jesus paita ishcai catiucunahuacpi ricurishcamanda
Chi punzhallata Jesusta quiriccunamanda ishcaipura (2) Emaus nishca llactama rinaura. Emaus llactaga Jerusalenmanda chaupi punzha purina tupu mara.
Paiguna riusha chi punzhagunai ima tucushcata cuintausha rinaura. Puriushcai Jesusllata paigunama caillayamusha paigunahuan pariu puringahua callarira.
Astahuanbas paigunahua ñahuigunaga puyushina tucucpi pai pi actas mana ricsinaurachu.
Chasna acpi Jesus paigunata tapura, Cangunapura casna puriusha imamandata cuintanacunguichi. Tapucpi paiguna shayarinaura yapa llaquirisha.
Shucca Cleofas nishca ac rimara, Cai punzhagunaibi Jerusalen llactai tucui imasna pasashcata canga manachu uyaranguiya. Carumanda shamuc asha chariya canlla mana yachangui nirami.

Ima llaquitara nisha tapura. Tapucpi paiguna ninaura, Nazaret llactamanda Jesusca Dios rimashcata pasachic runa mashca. Paiga Diospa ñaupacpi tucui runaguna ñaupacpias yapa ushaihuan aligunata rashcami, yapa yuyaihuan yachachishcami.

Paiga tucui ñucanchi israel llactata lugaryachingahua shamushca mara nisha yuyariranchi. Chasnagllaita ñucanchi pagrigunahua amuguna, ñucanchita mandaccunahuas paita japisha romanogunama cunaura cruspi huanchinauchun nisha. Chasna cucpi paita cruspi quilabasha huanchinaura. Ñáa cunan punzhahuan quimsa (3) punzha pactariunmi.
Chasnallata cunanga ñucanchi muntunmanda maican huarmiguna ñucanchita manzhachinaura. Paiguna cunan tutapagaricta Jesusta pambashca juctuma rinaushca
randi Jesuspa aichata mana tupanaushcachu. Chimanda bulltiasha rimanaura angelgunata ricuranchi nisha, chi angelgunaga Jesus causaunmi nisha rimac shamunaura.

Chasna nishcata uyasha maican ñucanchihuan tiyac runaguna chi pambashca juctuma risha huarmiguna rimashcacuintallata tupanaushca. Astahuanbas Jesus quiquinda mana tupanaurachu nisha chiguna cuintanaura.

Chi ishcai (2) runa cuintashcata uyasha Jesus paigunata nira, Canguna yuyai illacshina manguichi. Dios rimashcata ñaupa pasachiccuna quillcasha tucui yachachishcagunata imahuata mana tucui shunguhuan uctalla quirishcanguichi.
Quishpichic Cristo chara jatun mandac amu tucungahua manachu ñaupata turmintarina ara nira.

Jesus chasnallata Diospa shimibi tucui Cristomanda quillcashcagunata rimasha chi ishcai runata yachachira. Paimanda Moises quillcashcatas, tucui Dios rimashcata ñaupa pasachiccuna quillcashcagunatahuas chi ishcai runata yachachira.
Yachachisha puricpi paiguna riushca llactama pactanaura. Pactasha Jesusca mas caruma ringaraucshina rara.
Chasna riupi paiguna paita saquichingahua munasha ninaura, Ñáucanchihuan randi saquiri, ricui cunan yapa tutayaunmi nisha jarcanaura. Chasna nicpi huasi ucuma yaicusha paigunahuan saquirira.
Paiguna ña mesai tiyariushcai Jesus panda japisha Diosta pagrachu nisha, paquisha paigunatas cura.
Chi urasllaita paiguna ñahui pascarishcacuinta tucucpi Jesus acta ricsinaura. Chasna acpi paiguna ñaupagmandallata cungaimanda chingarira.
Chasna tucucpi paigunapura cuintanacungahua callarinaura, Ñáambibi shamushcai pai ñucanchita cuintausha Diospa shimita yachachiushcai manachu ñucanchi shungu ucuibi yapa ashcata cushiyaranchi.
Chasna rimanacusha chi urasllata jatarisha Jerusalenmallata bulltianaura. Chi Jesus japishca chunga shuc (11) runaguna, maican Jesushuan puriucunandi pariulla tandarisha tiyaushcama pactanaura.
Pactacpi chibi tiyaucuna rimanaura, Señor Jesus sirtu causarishcami, Simon Pedromasmi ricurishca mara.
Chasna rimacpi chi ishcai pactamuc runaguna Jesus ñambibi tucui cuintashcata chasnallata pai panda paquiushcai ricsiranchi nisha cuintanaura.
Jesus paita catiucunahuacpi ricurishcamanda
Paiguna chita cuintanacushcaibi Jesusca paiguna ñaupacpi cungaimanda ricurimura. Saludasha rimara, Cushi ganas causanguichi.
Rimacpi paigunaga shuc aya man nisha yapa manzharinaura.
Astahuanbas Jesus tapura, Imangahuata manzharinguichi, imaraicuta ñucata aya man nisha yuyaringuichi.
Ñáuca maquigunatas chaquigunatas ricuichi. Ñáucallata mani. Sirtu ñuca mana aya ashcata yachangahuaca ñucata llangasha camahuaichi. Ayaga mana charinzhu aichata tullutas ñuca charishcacuintaga nira.
Chasna nisha paihua maquigunatas chaquigunatas paigunama ricuchira.
Chasna ricuchicpihuas paigunaga yapa cushiyashallata chara manzharisha mana quirinaurachu. Chasna acpi Jesus tapura, Ima micunas caibi tiyanzhu ñuca micungahua.
Tapucpi yacu aicha chaquichishcata paima cunaura, ansa sacha mishquitahuas.
Paita cucpi japisha paiguna ñaupacpi micura.
Puchucai yachachina shimimanda

Micushcahuasha paigunata rimara, Ñáuca cangunahuan tiyausha chara mana huañushcallaita cangunata rimarani, tucui Diospa shimibi ñucamanda quillcashcaguna pactarina mara nisha. Moises quillcashcaibi, Dios rimashcata ñaupa pasachiccuna quillcashca shimigunaibis, Salmos nishca libroibihuas, tucui ñucamanda quillcashcagunaga pactarina mara. Tucui Diospa shimibi rimashcashinalla ña pactarishcami nira.
Chasna nishami paigunama yuyaita cura paiguna Diospa shimita alita yuyarisha intindingahua.

Chihuasha paigunata yachachisha nira, Diospa shimibi casna ñaupa quillcashca sirin, Quishpichic Cristoga turmintachisha huanchitucuna man, chasna agllaita quimsa (3) punzhaibi huañushcamanda causaringamiraun.

Chihuashaga Jerusalen llactamanda callarisha tucui llactagunama yachachiccunata cachangami casna nisha rimagrichun: Juchata rashcamanda llaquirisha saquisha nisha Yaya Diospagma shamuichi. Chasna racpiga Yaya Diosmi cangunahua juchagunataga anchuchingaraun nisha rimagrichun.
Chitaga canguna tucui ñucamanda Diospa shimibi pactarishcagunata ricushca ashami rimagriccuna anguichi.

Ricuichi, ñuca Yayaga cangunama ashca ushaita cushami nishcataga jahuapachamanda ñuca cangunama cachamushami canguna ali sinzhi tucungahua. Canguna chi ushaita charinagama Jerusalen llactallaita tiyanguichi nira.
Jesus jahuapachama rishcamanda

Chihuashami Jerusalenmanda Betania llacta mayanbi Jesus paigunata pushara. Chibi pactasha paihua maquigunata jahuama rasha paigunamanda Yaya Diosta tapura paigunata bindisiasha cuirasha yanapachun nisha.
Tapuushcaibi paigunamanda anchurisha jahuapachama apaitucura.
Paiguna Jesusta alabashcahuashami yapa cushiyasha Jerusalenma bulltianaura.
Chi llactaibi tiyausha Diosta alabana huasibi tucui uras Yaya Diosta alabasha tiyac anaura.
